name: M-3PO (Emtrey)
description: M-3PO, also known as Emtreypio or Emtrey, was a masculine M-3PO military protocol droid that served as the quartermaster of Rogue Squadron. Cobbled together from parts of other military protocol droids, he served the Rogues from their reformation in 6 ABY through to the Yuuzhan Vong War. Because of his improvised nature, he had a protocol droid's body and the head of a spaceport control droid.
